blocks.text: Stop 1: Four seasons in the UK

blocks.markdown:
The UK has four **seasons**: spring, summer, autumn and winter.

They come round in the same order every year.
blocks.say: A year is split into seasons. In the UK there are four. Spring is when new leaves and flowers grow, and baby animals are born. Summer is warm and sunny, with long days. Autumn is when leaves turn red and brown and fall. Winter is cold, with short days and sometimes snow. Then spring comes again. It is a circle that goes round and round.

scenes.say: In spring, the tree grows fresh green leaves and flowers.

scenes.say: In summer, the tree is full of leaves. The days are long and warm.

scenes.caption: Autumn: falling leaves.
scenes.say: In autumn, the leaves turn orange and fall down.

scenes.caption: Winter: cold and bare.
scenes.say: In winter, the branches are bare. It is cold and it may snow.

blocks.markdown:
Pakistan has hot summers, a rainy **monsoon**, mild autumns and cool winters.

Different places have different weather in the same season.
blocks.say: In Pakistan the seasons look different. Summer is very hot, and in many places the monsoon brings heavy rain in July and August. Autumn is mild. Winter is cool and sometimes it snows in the north, on the mountains. Then spring brings blossom, like almond flowers. So the same year has different weather in different countries.

blocks.caption: Monsoon rain, snowy mountains and spring blossom.

blocks.markdown:
**Weather** is what it is like outside: sunny, rainy, windy or cloudy.

It can change every day.
blocks.say: The weather is what it is like outside today. It can be sunny, rainy, windy, cloudy, snowy or foggy. It changes from day to day. Look at four kinds of weather.

blocks.say: A thermometer measures how hot or cold it is. The number on it is called the temperature. We measure it in degrees. The red line goes up when it is warm and goes down when it is cold. Look at what happens on a hot day.

blocks.markdown:
A **thermometer** measures the **temperature**.

A high number means it is hot. A low number means it is cold.

blocks.markdown:
We choose clothes to suit the **weather**.

Warm clothes for cold days, light clothes for hot days.
blocks.say: We choose clothes to suit the season and the weather. In winter we wear a coat, a scarf and gloves. In hot summer we wear light clothes and a sun hat. On rainy days we need a raincoat and boots. In Ramadan or at Eid, we wear special clothes too, but we still dress for the weather. Look at three outfits.

blocks.text: Stop 2: Stay safe in the sun

blocks.title: Sun safety plan
instructions: Draw yourself with a sun hat on.
Write three things that keep you safe in the sun.
blocks.say: The sun is strong in summer. Too much sun can burn our skin. So we wear a hat, drink water, and stay in the shade at midday. Never look straight at the sun, because it can hurt your eyes.
